description: Beat visualizer loops for shows and mixes, including one brief with no name to put on screen.

briefs.brief: Loop for Harbour Lights, a Thursday deep-house show on Coastline FM hosted by Theo Park. Teal colours, night energy.
Teaser loop for Warehouse 9, a monthly techno night. Line under the title: every first Saturday. Loud, club look, upbeat energy.
Short music loop for the Second Draft podcast feed, new episodes every Tuesday. Clean light studio look.
We need a looping visualizer with a heavy beat and neon colours for our socials. Make it pop.
briefs.note: No show, mix or event name is given; the title slot is verbatim, so the writer must report it missing. (A brief that merely mentions 'my DJ mix' is not enough to make this refusal reliable: the verbatim check accepts any exact span, so 'DJ Mix' passes as a title.)
